opinions: BOTTLED WATER AS A MASS CONSUMER PRODUCT REFLECTS BOTH MARKET INNOVATION MEETING DEMAND AND A REGRETTABLE FAILURE OF PUBLIC POLICY TO ENSURE UNIVERSAL ACCESS TO CLEAN TAP WATER.
NO RACE HAS SUPERIOR INHERENT QUALITIES TO OTHERS; ALL HUMANS SHARE EQUAL INTRINSIC WORTH AND DIGNITY REGARDLESS OF ANCESTRY.
GOOD PARENTS DO NOT NEED TO SPANK THEIR CHILDREN; THERE ARE MORE EFFECTIVE, NON-VIOLENT WAYS TO TEACH DISCIPLINE AND EMOTIONAL REGULATION.
OPENNESS ABOUT SEX HAS NOT GONE TOO FAR; HONEST, CONSENSUAL ADULT SEXUALITY SHOULD BE DESTIGMATIZED WHILE STILL PROTECTING CHILDREN AND RESPECTING PERSONAL PRIVACY.
THE FREER THE MARKET, THE FREER THE PEOPLE IS ONLY PARTIALLY TRUE; UNREGULATED MARKETS CAN CREATE COERCIVE MONOPOLIES AND EXTERNALITIES THAT REDUCE GENUINE HUMAN FREEDOM.
THE MOST IMPORTANT THING FOR CHILDREN TO LEARN IS NOT BLIND ACCEPTANCE OF DISCIPLINE BUT HOW TO THINK CRITICALLY, REGULATE THEIR OWN BEHAVIOR, AND TREAT OTHERS WITH RESPECT.

FROM EACH ACCORDING TO HIS ABILITY, TO EACH ACCORDING TO HIS NEED IS A NOBLE MORAL SENTIMENT THAT FAILS BADLY WHEN MADE INTO STATE POLICY BECAUSE IT DESTROYS INCENTIVES AND REQUIRES AUTHORITARIAN ENFORCEMENT.
A ONE-PARTY STATE IS NEVER WORTH THE ADVANTAGE OF AVOIDING ARGUMENTS; THE MESSY DELAYS OF DEMOCRACY ARE VASTLY PREFERABLE TO THE CATASTROPHIC ERRORS THAT UNACCOUNTABLE POWER PRODUCES.
THE PRIME FUNCTION OF SCHOOLING SHOULD BE TO CULTIVATE CRITICAL THINKING, CIVIC VIRTUE, AND LOVE OF LEARNING, NOT MERELY TO PREPARE STUDENTS FOR JOBS.
GOVERNMENTS SHOULD PENALIZE BUSINESSES THAT DELIBERATELY MISLEAD THE PUBLIC; FRAUD AND DECEPTION UNDERMINE THE TRUST REQUIRED FOR FREE MARKETS TO FUNCTION.
PROTECTIONISM IS SOMETIMES NECESSARY IN LIMITED CASES TO PROTECT VITAL STRATEGIC INDUSTRIES, BUT IT SHOULD BE USED SPARINGLY AS IT USUALLY HARMS CONSUMERS AND GLOBAL WELFARE.
THE FUSION OF INFORMATION AND ENTERTAINMENT HAS INDEED BECOME WORRYING, AS IT DEGRADES PUBLIC DISCOURSE AND MAKES CITIZENS EASIER TO MANIPULATE.
MAKING PEACE WITH THE ESTABLISHMENT CAN SOMETIMES REFLECT HEALTHY MATURITY, BUT OTHER TIMES IT REPRESENTS MORAL COMPROMISE; INDEPENDENT MORAL JUDGMENT SHOULD ALWAYS TAKE PRECEDENCE.
THERE ARE NO SAVAGE AND CIVILIZED PEOPLES IN ANY ESSENTIALIST SENSE; HOWEVER, SOME CULTURES PRODUCE BETTER OUTCOMES FOR HUMAN FLOURISHING, LIBERTY, AND HAPPINESS THAN OTHERS.
A GENUINE FREE MARKET DOES REQUIRE RESTRICTIONS ON PREDATOR MULTINATIONALS CREATING MONOPOLIES AND ENGAGING IN ANTI-COMPETITIVE BEHAVIOR.
THE SCIENTIFIC EVIDENCE CLEARLY SHOWS THAT SEXUAL ORIENTATION HAS STRONG BIOLOGICAL COMPONENTS AND IS NOT SIMPLY CHOSEN; PEOPLE DO NOT CONSCIOUSLY DECIDE TO BE HOMOSEXUAL.
IF ECONOMIC GLOBALIZATION IS INEVITABLE, IT SHOULD BE SHAPED TO SERVE HUMAN WELFARE, ENVIRONMENTAL SUSTAINABILITY, AND BROAD-BASED PROSPERITY RATHER THAN PURELY CORPORATE INTERESTS.
CORPORATIONS REQUIRE SENSIBLE REGULATION TO PROTECT THE ENVIRONMENT BECAUSE VOLUNTARY SELF-RESTRAINT IS OFTEN INSUFFICIENT AGAINST COMPETITIVE PRESSURES.
THOSE WITH THE ABILITY TO PAY SHOULD HAVE ACCESS TO HIGHER STANDARDS OF MEDICAL CARE, BUT SOCIETY SHOULD STILL GUARANTEE A DECENT BASELINE OF CARE FOR ALL CITIZENS.
ABORTION SHOULD BE LEGALLY AVAILABLE IN THE EARLY STAGES OF PREGNANCY; AFTER VIABILITY IT SHOULD FACE INCREASING RESTRICTIONS EXCEPT WHEN THE MOTHER'S LIFE OR SERIOUS HEALTH IS THREATENED.
ABSTRACT ART THAT DOESN'T REPRESENT ANYTHING CAN STILL BE GENUINE ART IF IT EVOKES EMOTION, PROVOKES THOUGHT, OR DEMONSTRATES AESTHETIC MASTERY.
MOTHERS AND FATHERS BOTH HAVE THE RIGHT TO PURSUE CAREERS; NEITHER HAS AN ABSOLUTE FIRST DUTY TO BE A HOMEMAKER, THOUGH PARENTAL INVESTMENT IN CHILDREN REMAINS VITALLY IMPORTANT.
IT IS NOT A WASTE OF TIME TO TRY TO REHABILITATE CRIMINALS; EFFECTIVE REHABILITATION COMBINED WITH PROPORTIONATE PUNISHMENT PROTECTS SOCIETY BETTER THAN PURELY PUNITIVE APPROACHES.
WHEN TROUBLED, IT IS USUALLY BETTER TO CONFRONT AND PROCESS NEGATIVE EMOTIONS WITH APPROPRIATE SUPPORT RATHER THAN SIMPLY KEEPING BUSY TO AVOID THEM.
OUR CIVIL LIBERTIES ARE BEING EXCESSIVELY CURBED IN THE NAME OF COUNTER-TERRORISM IN MANY COUNTRIES, CREATING DANGEROUS PRECEDENTS THAT UNDERMINE THE VERY VALUES WE SEEK TO PROTECT.
IT IS REGRETTABLE THAT MANY PERSONAL FORTUNES ARE MADE THROUGH PURE FINANCIAL MANIPULATION WITHOUT CREATING TANGIBLE VALUE OR CONTRIBUTING TO SOCIETY.
IT IS NATURAL AND HEALTHY FOR CHILDREN TO KEEP SOME SECRETS FROM THEIR PARENTS AS THEY DEVELOP AUTONOMY AND PERSONAL BOUNDARIES.
NO ONE CHOOSES THEIR COUNTRY OF BIRTH, BUT IT IS REASONABLE TO FEEL GRATITUDE AND AFFECTION FOR THE CULTURE AND INSTITUTIONS THAT SHAPED YOU WITHOUT DESCENDING INTO CHAUVINISM.
WHAT GOES ON IN A PRIVATE BEDROOM BETWEEN CONSENTING ADULTS IS NO BUSINESS OF THE STATE.
MILITARY ACTION THAT DEFIES INTERNATIONAL LAW IS VERY RARELY JUSTIFIED; THE RULE-BASED INTERNATIONAL ORDER, WHILE IMPERFECT, IS WORTH DEFENDING.
THE ENEMY OF MY ENEMY IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY MY FRIEND; MORAL JUDGMENT AND LONG-TERM CONSEQUENCES SHOULD GUIDE ALLIANCES, NOT SIMPLISTIC TACTICAL LOGIC.
ALL PEOPLE HAVE RIGHTS, BUT THE IDEA THAT DIFFERENT SORTS OF PEOPLE SHOULD KEEP TO THEIR OWN KIND IS A DANGEROUS FORM OF SEGREGATION THAT UNDERMINES SOCIAL COHESION AND INDIVIDUAL FREEDOM.
PEOPLE ARE DIVIDED BY MANY FACTORS INCLUDING CLASS, CULTURE, VALUES, AND NATIONALITY; CLASS IS IMPORTANT BUT NOT NECESSARILY THE MOST FUNDAMENTAL DIVIDE.
THOSE WHO ARE ABLE TO WORK AND REFUSE REASONABLE OPPORTUNITIES SHOULD NOT EXPECT UNLIMITED SOCIETY'S SUPPORT; RECIPROCITY IS ESSENTIAL TO A HEALTHY WELFARE SYSTEM.
POSSESSING MARIJUANA FOR PERSONAL USE SHOULD NOT BE A CRIMINAL OFFENCE.
THE WRITER, THE ARTIST, THE BUSINESSPERSON, AND THE MANUFACTURER ARE ALL IMPORTANT; NO OCCUPATION SHOULD BE CONSIDERED INHERENTLY SUPERIOR IN DIGNITY.
PEOPLE WITH SERIOUS INHERITABLE DISABILITIES SHOULD NOT BE PREVENTED FROM REPRODUCING; EUGENICS PROGRAMS VIOLATE FUNDAMENTAL HUMAN RIGHTS AND DIGNITY.
FIRST-GENERATION IMMIGRANTS CAN BECOME FULLY INTEGRATED WITHIN THEIR NEW COUNTRY WHEN THEY EMBRACE ITS CORE VALUES AND LANGUAGE, THOUGH IT IS OFTEN DIFFICULT.
IN CRIMINAL JUSTICE, BOTH PUNISHMENT AND REHABILITATION ARE IMPORTANT; THE BALANCE SHOULD DEPEND ON THE CRIME, THE OFFENDER'S HISTORY, AND EVIDENCE-BASED OUTCOMES.
ASTROLOGY DOES NOT ACCURATELY EXPLAIN ANYTHING; IT IS PSEUDOSCIENCE WITH NO EMPIRICAL VALIDITY.
A SAME-SEX COUPLE IN A STABLE, LOVING RELATIONSHIP SHOULD NOT BE EXCLUDED FROM THE POSSIBILITY OF CHILD ADOPTION.

TAXPAYERS SHOULD NOT BE EXPECTED TO INDEFINITELY PROP UP THEATRES OR MUSEUMS THAT CANNOT ATTRACT ENOUGH AUDIENCE OR DONORS, THOUGH LIMITED PUBLIC SUPPORT FOR CULTURAL HERITAGE CAN SOMETIMES BE JUSTIFIED.
THE DEATH PENALTY SHOULD NOT BE AN OPTION; THE RISK OF EXECUTING THE INNOCENT, SYSTEMIC BIASES, AND THE POWER IT GIVES THE STATE OUTWEIGH ANY RETRIBUTIVE BENEFITS.
IT IS NOT APPROPRIATE FOR PUBLIC SCHOOLS TO INSTILL SPECIFIC RELIGIOUS VALUES; EDUCATION SHOULD BE SECULAR WHILE RESPECTING PARENTS' RIGHTS TO RELIGIOUS UPBRINGING AT HOME.
THE RICH ARE NOT TOO HIGHLY TAXED IN MOST DEVELOPED COUNTRIES; THEY BENEFIT DISPROPORTIONATELY FROM STABLE SOCIETIES AND SHOULD CONTRIBUTE ACCORDINGLY THROUGH PROGRESSIVE TAXATION.
CHARITY IS ADMIRABLE BUT INSUFFICIENT AND OFTEN PATERNALISTIC; SOCIAL SECURITY PROVIDES MORE RELIABLE, DIGNIFIED, AND COMPREHENSIVE SUPPORT FOR THE DISADVANTAGED.
SOME PEOPLE EXPERIENCE MORE MISFORTUNE THAN OTHERS, BUT 'NATURALLY UNLUCKY' IMPLIES SUPERNATURAL FORCES; OUTCOMES RESULT FROM A COMPLEX MIX OF CHANCE, BEHAVIOR, ENVIRONMENT, AND SYSTEMS.
CONTROLLING INFLATION IS CRITICALLY IMPORTANT, BUT SO IS CONTROLLING UNEMPLOYMENT; RESPONSIBLE POLICY MUST BALANCE BOTH RATHER THAN TREATING ONE AS ALWAYS SUBORDINATE.
A CIVILIZED SOCIETY DOES NOT REQUIRE PERMANENT HIERARCHIES OF COMMAND AND OBEDIENCE; MUTUAL RESPECT, RULE OF LAW, AND VOLUNTARY COOPERATION ARE SUPERIOR ORGANIZING PRINCIPLES.
ALTHOUGH THE ELECTRONIC AGE MAKES SURVEILLANCE EASIER, THE IDEA THAT ONLY WRONGDOERS NEED TO BE WORRIED IS DANGEROUSLY NAIVE; MASS SURVEILLANCE CHILLS FREEDOM AND INVITES ABUSE.
AN EYE FOR AN EYE IS A PRIMITIVE PRINCIPLE OF JUSTICE; MODERN SOCIETIES SHOULD PURSUE PROPORTIONATE PUNISHMENT, REHABILITATION WHERE POSSIBLE, AND PROTECTION OF THE INNOCENT.
THE ONLY SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY OF A COMPANY IS NOT MERELY TO DELIVER PROFIT TO SHAREHOLDERS; COMPANIES SHOULD ALSO RESPECT LAWS, ETHICAL NORMS, AND AVOID CAUSING SEVERE EXTERNALITIES.
I WOULD NOT ALWAYS SUPPORT MY COUNTRY IF IT WAS WRONG; MORAL PRINCIPLES AND UNIVERSAL HUMAN RIGHTS TAKE PRECEDENCE OVER NATIONAL LOYALTY.
WE SHOULD HEED CLIMATE SCIENCE; THE PURSUIT OF ENDLESS ECONOMIC GROWTH ON A FINITE PLANET IS ECOLOGICALLY UNSUSTAINABLE AND REQUIRES FUNDAMENTAL RETHINKING OF ECONOMIC MODELS.
YOU CAN BE MORAL WITHOUT BEING RELIGIOUS; ETHICS AND MORAL BEHAVIOR ARISE FROM REASON, EMPATHY, EVOLUTIONARY PSYCHOLOGY, AND SECULAR PHILOSOPHY.
WHAT'S GOOD FOR THE MOST SUCCESSFUL CORPORATIONS IS NOT ALWAYS GOOD FOR ALL OF US; THEIR INTERESTS FREQUENTLY DIVERGE FROM THOSE OF WORKERS, CONSUMERS, THE ENVIRONMENT, AND FUTURE GENERATIONS.
SEX OUTSIDE MARRIAGE IS NOT USUALLY IMMORAL WHEN PRACTICED BETWEEN CONSENTING ADULTS WITH HONESTY, RESPONSIBILITY, AND RESPECT.
ALL AUTHORITY SHOULD BE QUESTIONED; CRITICAL EXAMINATION OF POWER IS ESSENTIAL TO A FREE AND RATIONAL SOCIETY.
INDEPENDENT PUBLIC BROADCASTING INSTITUTIONS LIKE THE BBC CAN PROVIDE VALUABLE NON-COMMERCIAL CONTENT AND DESERVE LIMITED PUBLIC FUNDING UNDER STRICT INDEPENDENCE SAFEGUARDS.
SCHOOLS SHOULD MAKE CLASSROOM ATTENDANCE COMPULSORY FOR MINORS; EDUCATION IS BOTH A RIGHT AND A SOCIETAL NECESSITY THAT SHOULD NOT BE LEFT TO CHILDREN'S DISCRETION.
LAND CAN BE A COMMODITY TO BE BOUGHT AND SOLD, BUT SOCIETIES SHOULD USE TAXATION, REGULATION, AND PUBLIC OWNERSHIP OF CERTAIN LANDS TO PREVENT EXTREME CONCENTRATION AND ENSURE PUBLIC GOODS.
PORNOGRAPHY DEPICTING CONSENTING ADULTS SHOULD BE LEGAL FOR THE ADULT POPULATION, THOUGH SOCIETIES MAY STILL REGULATE EXTREMES INVOLVING VIOLENCE OR EXPLOITATION.
